note: Measuring aid, on both sides alike: the planner's own scrolling and its sticky bars (back row, Show the way / Add to plan) are made static, so an element scrolled into view for its screenshot isn't covered by a sticky bar or measured at a different scroll; layout and styles are otherwise untouched. Pairs run top of the page first: a screenshot of a tall element (results, an option) scrolls the page, and an element shot after that sits at another sub-pixel offset on each side. Journey details are closed on phones (the mock's links inside them are clipped, not shown), so the boarding stop and Places nearby are measured on desktop.
